title: assure.RecordProofRun
description: Builds the proof run from the suites' output at the clean, full commit checked out, adds a failed outcome with the detail did not run for each automated test record that has none, refuses an unknown test ID or a signer that is not the trusted signer, and hands the proof run to the attestation store.

title: assure.GateChange
description: Measures the coverage at the change's commit and at the base head with MeasureCoverage, lists the workflow files that differ, verifies the proof run at the change's commit with VerifyAttestation, and refuses the change when holdsRatchet or proofRunPassed gives a cause, or when the only proof run is change grade and the workflows folder changed. The decision names both commits and both coverages, lists every reason in the fixed order, is checked by the rules of the Gate decision, and is kept by the decision store. The code standard's predicates are not wired in yet (ST-ASR-UC02-R05).

title: assure.GateRelease
description: Not written yet.

title: compiler.ResolveDependencies
description: ResolveDependencies refuses while the plan has output changes, runs go mod tidy with a fixed environment, checks the result, and writes through the journal.

title: appbuild.Download
description: Download fetches the zips for one revision and checks them against go.sum.

title: appbuild.Build
description: Build checks the SDK against the compiler's pinned release, builds twice, compares, and writes build.json. It does not read the archetype's pin and writes no SBOM yet.

title: appbuild.BuildImage
description: BuildImage checks the trusted build record and the CA bundle, then writes a scratch image and image.json.

title: appbuild.SignImage
description: Not written yet: images are signed with GitHub attestations in stego's own application-images workflow.

title: appbuild.PublishImage
description: PublishImage pushes the verified image over TLS with an explicit CA and credentials, then reads it back.

title: compiler.Initialize
description: Initialize checks the archetype, refuses an existing declaration, then writes the scaffold and the fills folder with exclusive creates.

title: lifecycle.Supersede
description: Not written yet.

title: lifecycle.Withdraw
description: Not written yet.

title: qualify
description: qualify selects the runs by head commit with select_run, and require_jobs and require_artifacts require every named job and the one signed compiler artifact.

title: verify_published_release
description: verify_published_release checks the tag and the immutable release, installs it through installer.install, and compares every asset digest and the release notes.

title: install
description: install checks the revision, the platform and the result folder first, downloads each asset by its fixed ID, checks its size and digest, then calls verification.verify.

title: delivery.WriteRequirements

title: kubernetesservice.Generator
description: Writes a render program and a Containerfile that runs go mod download with the network on; it writes no kustomize base yet.

title: delivery.WriteApplication
description: Not written yet.

title: delivery.CheckCandidate
description: Not written yet.

title: main.runFillCreate
description: runFillCreate resolves the slot, refuses an existing fill or an unsafe name, and writeFillScaffold writes fill.yaml, the code and a test.

title: main.runTest
description: runTest runs go test ./fills/... and records nothing. It does not check for test files or imports, and writes no evidence yet.

title: main.runFillSign
description: Not written yet: no command signs a fill.

title: compiler.Apply
description: Apply checks the plan against the project, the registry and the compiler (verifyPlanLocation and verifyRegistry in snapshot.go), then commitTransaction in transaction.go writes the files through the journal and saves the record last. It plans in the same run, and cannot read a saved plan yet. It does not yet refuse a hand-edited file, and it has no flag that allows replacing hand edits.

title: compiler.Recover
description: Recover validates the journal against every file, refuses a conflict before it writes, and completes the apply.

title: compiler.SavePlan
description: Not written yet: SavePlan will save the plan that Reconcile in reconciler.go makes. Today Reconcile makes the plan in memory, and nothing saves it.

title: browserassets.PackDirectory
description: PackDirectory checks the folder and Encode writes the archive; WriteFile replaces the output only after every check passes.

title: compiler.WriteArchitecture
description: Not written yet: no apply writes an architecture view.

title: registry.LoadDirectories
description: STEGO has no command that writes a component: a platform engineer writes component.yaml, and LoadDirectories accepts it. It decodes the file strictly, refuses a name that differs from its folder, and refuses a slot with no contract file. validateComponentNamespaces in internal/compiler/namespace.go refuses an overlapping namespace when a service is checked.

title: registry.CheckRelease
description: Not written yet: nothing compares a component's emitted code with its version today. This names where that check will live.

title: registry.ResolveRegistry
description: ResolveRegistry reads the sources from .stego/config.yaml and resolves each pinned Git source or vendored checkout at its exact commit. LoadDirectories then refuses a part that occurs in more than one source.

title: registry.Introduce
description: Not written yet: no component declares a stage today. This names where the maturity ladder will be kept.

title: registry.Graduate
description: Not written yet: no component declares a stage today. This names where the maturity ladder will be kept.

title: registry.Withdraw
description: Not written yet: no component declares a stage today. This names where the maturity ladder will be kept.

title: parser.ParseArchetypeFromBytes
description: STEGO accepts an archetype when LoadDirectories decodes archetype.yaml through ParseArchetypeFromBytes. It refuses no stage today, and ports.Resolve finds an unanswered or ambiguous port only when a service is checked, not when the archetype is written.

title: parser.ParseMixinFromBytes
description: STEGO accepts a mixin when LoadDirectories decodes mixin.yaml through ParseMixinFromBytes and finds the contract of each slot it adds. Nothing refuses a mixin that replaces a part, or that brings a component that is not ga, yet.

title: registry.DefinePort
description: Not written yet: a port has no definition of its own today. This names where it will live.

title: Registry.checkSlots
description: checkSlots refuses a slot whose name makes an unsafe path, or whose contract is not at slots/<name>.proto in the component's folder.

title: registry.RecordEvidence

title: registry.Promote
description: Not written yet: a component moves to the common registry only by a hand-made change today.
